ai.title: China steps up AI warfare push, integrates loyal wingman drones into pilot training
ai.description: China is expanding the use of artificial intelligence in military aviation, bringing loyal wingman drones into routine fighter pilot training. PLA simulations now allow pilots to practise coordinated combat missions with unmanned aircraft while facing complex battlefield scenarios. The development follows earlier efforts to validate manned-unmanned operations involving China's J-20 stealth fighter and GJ-11 combat drone.

ai.title: How AI is reshaping real estate
ai.description: The rise of artificial intelligence is reshaping the real estate industry and regulators are racing to draft rules to draw a line between virtual home staging and false advertising, which is now referred to as housefishing.

ai.title: Musk's SpaceX gets FCC nod for 1 million satellites to power orbital data centres
ai.description: The Federal Communications Commission has authorized SpaceX to deploy a constellation of 1 million satellites. This decision is aimed at facilitating data processing for Earth-based applications. The satellites will be used to meet the increasing demand for artificial intelligence computing capacities globally. SpaceX aims to utilize the Starmind constellation for its orbital compute modules. This initiative highlights the growing need for advanced data processing infrastructures in space.
